title: ci: update sigstore rekor test images
body:
The old trillian_log_server/trillian_log_signer images were removed and can no longer be pulled, move to the new location for them and also update rekor-server and the db_server image while at it.

This also requires the removal of --enable_stable_checkpoint which is no longer supported.
